annotations.title: Connect an agent to this inbox, permanently

description: Start connecting an agent to this inbox address, permanently -- the SAME address. Works whether this is a brand-new trial inbox OR one that's already been claimed by a different agent before: more than one agent can independently connect to the same inbox, each getting its own separate, revocable connection. Returns a claim_url immediately -- share it in chat right away. The human clicks it, enters their email, enters the one-time code Inbin sends there, and a credential is ISSUED. That is NOT the same as the connection working yet -- the human still has to install that credential into an MCP client's config before anything can actually use it, and you will never see the credential itself, by design. Call await_trial_inbox_claim afterward to see the human finish the email+code step, then claim_connection_status (repeatedly, possibly much later -- installing a client is not instant) to see whether a client has actually started using it. The inbox must still exist (not yet expired) for this to work; it does not need to still be a TRIAL inbox specifically.

connector_label.description: Optional label identifying which agent/client is connecting, e.g. 'Research assistant'. Shown to the human as the name of this specific connection so they can tell multiple connections apart later.

inbox_address.description: The exact inbox address to connect to, e.g. abc123@in.inbin.dev.

name: claim_trial_inbox
